audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags: 'level chart contradicts data: Ezreal wins only 46.89% but the chart gives Ezreal 6/7 stages vs 1.'
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content win[] already agree with each other (both give Ezreal 6 stages, Sivir 1), and the stage-by-stage prose (whys/spikes) all argue Ezreal poking freely except her 1st-item shove spike — so the two layers are internally consistent, and I cannot tell from the kits alone whether the per-stage calls or the aggregate winrate is the stale one. Nothing in ownerKit/enemyKit resolves which is right.
Spikes correctly cover level 3-5 (Ezreal poke, bait Spell Shield), level 6 (Trueshot vs Sivir's utility ult), 1st item (On the Hunt shove-and-roam), and late (max-charge Q kiting).
